root_cause.text: The bt_host_release() function, when called for an unregistered HCI device (HCI_UNREGISTER flag not set), frees the device via kfree() without first calling cleanup_srcu_struct() on the SRCU structure initialized in hci_alloc_dev(), causing a percpu memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `cleanup_srcu_struct(&hdev->srcu);` before `kfree(hdev);` in the else branch of bt_host_release(). The commit message states: "Because hci_release_dev() is bypassed, the SRCU struct initialized early in hci_alloc_dev() is never cleaned up, resulting in a leak of percpu memory."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing SRCU cleanup when releasing an unregistered HCI device.
intent_record.what: Added braces and a call to cleanup_srcu_struct(&hdev->srcu) in the else branch of bt_host_release, before kfree(hdev).
intent_record.how: When HCI_UNREGISTER flag is not set, the SRCU structure is now cleaned up before freeing the hdev device, preventing a resource leak and potential use-after-free.
